body:
**On-Demand | 36 minutes**

Discover how to take your 3D printing to the next level with **polypropylene (PP)** and **SAF™ (Selective Absorption Fusion) technology**.

Watch this 1-hour webinar to learn how SAF enables strong, lightweight, and chemically resistant parts—perfect for functional, end-use applications across industries.

Watch the webinar!
